answer: The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Reaching the sonnet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The pulse is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the glacier. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
